rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits high melanin saturation, estimated at approximately 95% or greater, with dark black pigmentation covering the entire apex and only minimal lighter tonality near the lower philtrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark vertical linear mark or scar is visible on the midline of the nasal bridge, located superior to the rhinarium.
other_distinctive_markers: There is a prominent patch of bright white fur on the chin (mental region) that contrasts sharply with the beige/tan fur of the mystacial pads.
